source_state.binding_policy: Exact pinned source bytes below are authoritative. The gate must be rerun after the remediation worktree is committed as the new immutable candidate so repository_head records that candidate commit.

purpose: Provide an explicit runnable successor to the historical P2/AG-05 production-postprocess contract. It binds the current saliency source bytes, preserves the previously frozen thresholds, exercises all five real-weight fixtures, checks untouched production E2E values and features, and does not rewrite any historical contract or report.

historical_reference_contract.role: Immutable P10 source for five fixture identities, frozen legacy arrays, checkpoint identity and historical correlation evidence. Its historical verdict is not substituted for this current execution.

threshold_authority.policy: No threshold is newly defined, relaxed or tightened in current_v2.

comparison_policy.production_e2e: The actual captured predict_saliency return value is checked directly and must not be normalized, rescaled, clipped or offset by the gate.
comparison_policy.production_self_check: Apply the pinned production postprocessor to captured production raw output and require exact equality with captured production E2E output.
comparison_policy.legacy_reference: Apply the pinned production postprocessor once to the frozen legacy raw array at the fixture's original dimensions.
comparison_policy.output_contract: Production E2E must be float32, finite, correctly shaped and either span exactly [0,1] or be the defined constant all-zero map.
comparison_policy.feature_check: Run the pinned production feature extractor on untouched production E2E and the one-time postprocessed legacy reference; compare all five named features.
comparison_policy.peak_check: Use the production peak mask and require exact peak count and exact peak-mask positions.
comparison_policy.expected_output_identity: Each production E2E array SHA-256 must equal the prospective value frozen in expected_production_e2e_sha256 before current_v2 execution.

arguments.fixtures_root: external directory containing the five hash-pinned fixture filenames

execution.post_commit_requirement: Rerun this exact current contract after all Stage-1 audit remediations are committed as the new immutable candidate; repository_head in the report must then equal that candidate commit.

out_of_scope: Any rewrite of historical P8, P9, P10 or P2 contracts, reports, thresholds or verdicts
Changes to saliency computation or feature definitions
